trainer/31580.htm.text: Master Galadrid: No matter your race or class, you must acquire a solid foundation before you can even think of using more advanced techniques. That's just common sense, isn't it?

trainer/31580-noteach.htm.text: Master Galadrid: You should go talk to Master Hardin. He'd be a much more appropriate teacher for you.

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-01.htm.text: Master Galadrid: So you've been chosen? Are you up to it? We're stretched to our limits, but I have a plan.

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-04.htm.text: Master Galadrid: You must complete this mission before you move on. Meet with Samael of Goddard Castle Town !

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-06.htm.text: Master Galadrid: You uncovered the secrets of the ancient relic! What did Shiken have to say?

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-09.htm.text: Master Galadrid: Your abilities finally match your understanding. I bestow upon you the title of Shillien Templar!

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-010.ht.text: Master Galadrid: You've already approached a higher level of knowledge than the other knights, but your ability hasn't reached the level of knowledge. Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-02.htm.text: Master Galadrid: Keep honing your skills for a while. (This quest may only be undertaken by a Shillien Knight of level 76 or above.)

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-03.htm.text: Master Galadrid: Meet with Samael of Goddard Castle Town to find out what to do next. You should know that nobody has succeeded in this mission before. Beware, Shiken may try to stop you! Oh, I have a letter for you.

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-05.htm.text: Master Galadrid: Samael of Goddard Castle Town has deciphered the ancient text on the relic. Will you conduct an investigation based on his translation?

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-07.htm.text: Master Galadrid: That sounds like Shiken, alright! You've proven yourself a worthy Knight. I bestow upon you the title of Shillien Templar!

Q00097_SagaOfTheShillienTemplar/0-08.htm.text: Master Galadrid: Then, if so, there's nothing I can say to you. You've already approached a higher level of knowledge than the other knights. links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
